# opnsense_interfaces_lagg (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense link aggregation interface.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (Set of String) Member interfaces.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `hash_layers` (Set of String) Hash layers selected from `l2`, `l3`, and `l4`.
- `lacp_fast_timeout` (Boolean) Enable LACP fast timeout.
- `lacp_strict` (String) LACP strict mode: empty for system default, `1` for yes, or `0` for no.
- `mtu` (Number) Optional MTU. When unset, OPNsense uses the smallest member MTU.
- `primary_member` (String) Primary member for failover mode. Must also be in members.
- `protocol` (String) Aggregation protocol.
- `use_flow_id` (String) Use RSS flow ID: empty for system default, `1` for yes, or `0` for no.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Automatically allocated LAGG device name.
- `id` (String) UUID of the LAGG configuration.
